_comment: The Reading (Expansion 6 F.4, game/story/reading.py): a seer's or a hermit's offer to lay the Wayfarer's Deck. Offered from talk or at a wonder, never by the director (weight 0). {seer_intro} and {seer_ask} are written by story/reading.offer from reading.json.

title: The cards
{seer} reads
The Wayfarer's Deck
At {seer}'s fire
text: {seer_intro} The light is going, and the fire is the brightest thing for a mile.
{seer_intro} Somewhere behind you a dog barks, and stops, as if told to.

label: Cross {seer}'s palm with {price}.
Pay {price}, and sit down by the fire.
result: The coin vanishes somewhere about {seer}. The cards are cut, and cut again, and laid down one by one on the cloth.
"Good," says {seer}, and the first card goes down on the cloth, face up.

label: Offer a favour instead: an hour's work about the fire.
Carry water and wood for an hour, as the price.
result: You fetch, carry, mend and stack until {seer} is satisfied, and then sit down, and the cards come out.
An hour of work, and {seer} nods at last, and lays out the cards.

label: Not today.
result: {seer} shrugs, and the cards go back into their cloth. "The road will still be there."
"Another time, then," says {seer}, not at all surprised.
